# CareYour.Pet — Pet Health Management Platform
> Track vaccinations, medical history, weight, and connect with veterinarians.

## Key Features
- Pet medical records and history
- Vaccination tracking
- Veterinary clinic integration (web + mobile app)
- Multi-pet household management
- Pet passport generation
- Breeder tools
- AI veterinary assistant (DeepSeek-powered)

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Redis
- Mobile: React Native (Expo)
- AI: DeepSeek API

## API Endpoints (REST)
- `/api/pets/` — Pet CRUD, feed, pedigree, sharing
- `/api/events/` — Medical events for pets
- `/api/categories/` — Species and breed taxonomy
- `/api/ai/consult/` — AI veterinary consultation
- `/api/chat/` — Owner-vet messaging
